blurb: Black Mesa State Park is a dark sky park. During quiet hours (11:00 pm to 7:00 am) guests are asked to keep lights to a minimum. Turn off exterior lights during quiet hours and turn off exterior lights when going to bed for the night. No decorative lighting or excessive exterior lights should be used. Use of red light flashlights is encouraged.
